decision: Raw selection/confirmation audit accepted. Qualification permits reporting the measured comparisons; it is not a statistical test of speed superiority.
scope: Final three admitted head settings plus unchanged span control and 103 comparator configurations, all on the same allocation and original 16 exposed development cases. Native initialization and six host output fields are included; accuracy uses the five requested evolved outputs. All measured negatives and the near-POD tie are retained. No global-optimality, held-out, cross-job timing or broad speed claim.

near_POD_tie_interpretation.interpretation: The ratio near one and mixed case rankings do not establish robust speed superiority. All three heads lose to the eligible coarse spectral comparator on all 16 cases.
